alerts.reason: Revenue growth slowed from 25.87% to 11.03% year over year. California’s April NEM 2.0 deadline pulled demand forward, while higher installation capacity helped sustain second-quarter volume (A, B). I expect installations from pre-deadline demand to keep the intervening quarter above −5.00%, then taper enough for revenue to fall at least 5.00% year over year in the quarter starting October 2. The timing is uncertain because the records do not quantify remaining pre-deadline orders.
